messages:
Release Manager: Quick final check for the 17:00 change window. Short checklist: 1) pin model variants if needed 2) confirm canary health 3) fallback route + rollback steps 4) release notes published. Anyone seeing blockers?
Alex M.: Re: pin — we need to pin embedder -> `embedder-v3.0.1` due to tokenization change. I can run the pin after canary green.
Priya S.: On docs: release notes draft is in the doc, link: https://go/internal/release/123. Need signoff on the known-regressions section.
Jordan L.: Oncall, are we good on capacity for burst? Metrics look ok but want one more check.
Oncall SRE: @Jordan L. I'm running a quick load test now, 5m run. Will post results.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started on pool:dedicated-us-west-2, canaries: 3 -> 10, target traffic: 5%
deploy-bot: Canary health: 3/3 healthy, median latency +12ms, error rate 0.02% :white_check_mark:
Alex M.: If canary stays green for 10m, I'll run `rctl pin model=embedder@v3.0.1` then push canary to 25%.
Priya S.: Signed off on release notes with a note about a minor encoder edge-case under investigation.
Jordan L.: Load test: 15m peak sims, no throttles, CPU headroom ~25%, GPU memory stable.
Oncall SRE: Rollback plan ready: step 1 unroute canary -> revert traffic to v2.9, step 2 pin fallback v2.9 in place, step 3 open incident and escalate.
Alex M.: Pin command ready, posting command here for audit: ```rctl pin service=embedder version=v3.0.1 --reason "tokenization fix"``` 
Priya S.: Can we also include a quick eval set post-pin to verify outputs match expected? I can run three prompts.
Jordan L.: Agree. I'll coordinate the evals and watch logs.
Release Manager: Timing: wait for 10m green + evals. If all clean, we go to 25% and monitor 30m. Final decision at +45 from now. Please react with :thumbsup: when you're ready.
Alex M.: :thumbsup:
Priya S.: :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: :thumbsup:
Oncall SRE: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary traffic increased to 25% by operator request.
deploy-bot: Canary health at 25%: 10/10 healthy, latency +- baseline, no regressions reported.
Release Manager: All clear. Proceeding with canary ramp and release notes publish. Recording final state in the release doc. Thanks everyone :tada:
